title: Finding
description: The Judge's verdict on one piece for one concept, or a Layer 1 detector hit. Veil contract v1.0. Units: positions and sizes are integer screen pixels with the origin at the top-left of the display in its current orientation (x grows right, y grows down); times are integer milliseconds on one monotonic clock (Android SystemClock.uptimeMillis; replays use a virtual clock in the same unit); fingerprints are L2-normalised vectors stored as float16.

lookId.description: The look this finding belongs to.

frameId.description: Frame the piece was cut from.

image.description: Screenshot file name in offline evaluation.

rect.description: Bounds of the finding on screen.

conceptId.description: The concept judged; Layer 1 ids look like l1.nudity and l1.abuse.

layer.description: 1 is the always-on safety layer, 2 is the user's own list.

decision.description: hide is a confident finding; nearMiss is a near-threshold finding that only keeps existing covers alive; leave is no finding.

probability.description: Probability that the piece matches the concept.

scope.description: Cover only the object, or the whole element around it.
